Name: Bouquets to Love Letters
Author: TheAppleSauceIsStale
Description:
My first mod, which replaces both bouquets with some simple love letters, and edits Pierre's related letter to you.

Add some extra cuteness to dating, or just[i] really[/i] lean into that lighthearted anime aesthetic!

Other mods seen in images:

- Stardew Valley Expanded + Medieval Reskin
- Yellog's Furniture
- Rustic Country Walls and Floors
- Sailor Moon Hairstyles Clothing and Kimono
